unit.title: 3D Shapes
unit.blurb: Naming cubes, cuboids, cylinders, cones, spheres, pyramids and prisms, and counting their faces, edges and vertices.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Identify, describe and sort 3D shapes, including prisms and pyramids, and find them in everyday objects.

O2.t: Count the faces, edges and vertices of 3D shapes.

p: 3D shapes are solid. Some have **flat faces** (cube, cuboid, pyramid, prism) and some have **curved surfaces** (sphere, cylinder, cone).
A **prism** is the same shape all the way through. A **pyramid** has faces that meet at a point.
A square is flat (2D). A cube is solid (3D) and has 6 square faces.

p: A **face** is a surface. An **edge** is where two faces meet. A **vertex** is a corner (more than one: **vertices**).
A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.
Some faces, edges and corners are at the back. Count those too.
